title: Skins Unlocker
features:
🐟 Animal Sim: Underwater 🦈

This script unlocks all skins by turning on every BoolValue in the game. Yeah, most games(tho I know only one game) use BoolValues to track if you own a skin, like when you buy a skin and e.t.c, it flips from false to true. This script just sets them all to true at once so you get everything. It also enables all other BoolValues in the game which might let you do stuff like swimming in air or other abilities that are basically locked. After it's done, a notification pops up that says that the script is working and skins are unlocked, bla bla bla.

By the way, the script is open-source! Feel free to use it in your projects.
